values.formSubmittedText: Results received — reconciliation is running. A summary email is on its way.

parameters.content:
## Phase 3 — Remittance Reconciliation

After uploading the bulk claim CSV to PRODA/myplace, the admin downloads the portal's payment results file and drops it on this form (URL path: /form/ndis-payment-results).

The workflow matches every row back to the claims ledger by ClaimReference, marks each claim paid (with amount + date) or rejected (with reason), and emails a summary: paid total, rejection/resubmission queue, and anything unmatched. Header names in the results file are matched tolerantly, so minor portal format changes won't break it.
